title: Coral and the Hymn
author: Edmund Thackeray
blurb: Tamsin Halloran, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
